CustomField.label: Unit Group
CustomField.description: Automatic size band for the property, derived from Units (Display). Requested by Niraj 2026-07-29 for the PAL/ROE acquisition refocus so the on-net MDU pipeline can be grouped by property size. Bands are < 25 / 25-49 / 50-100 / > 100 and are mutually exclusive: a 50-unit property is "50-100", a 100-unit property is "50-100", 101 and above is "> 100". This matches the rule already applied in the "TX-NE ON Net MDUs - with Salesforce" workbook, so the counts Niraj circulated stay intact.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Automatic. Size band from the unit count: < 25, 25-49, 50-100, or > 100. Blank when the unit count is unknown.
